reasoning_content: Now I see the web root is at /opt/wasd/client/public/. Let me check nginx config and find where it's serving from.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check nginx config
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("cat /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null | head -30")
print("Nginx:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if client/public exists
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/wasd/client/public/")
print("\nPublic:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
